How PHN Works

Three identity layers. One reward loop. Fully on-chain, non-custodial, and governed by a timelock.

Step 01
x

Triple Identity Verification

Every node must pass three gates simultaneously: a hashed PC identity, a human-attestation hash, and a peaq machine DID string. No spoofing. No bots.

Step 02
x

Heartbeat & Accrual

Registered node operators call heartbeat() on NodeEarningsManager. Each valid heartbeat accrues PHN at the configured policy rate only for active, verified nodes.

Step 03
a

Claim from the Vault

Call claim() to withdraw earned PHN directly from the NodeRewardVault. Privileged controls route through a timelock no rug, no surprises.

Cross-Chain via LayerZero OFT
